verdicts.reason: A: the SOLSTICE logo is shrunk to an illegible speck in the top-right corner, and the oversized NEW FLAVOR badge outweighs it. The can is reduced to a small object on a big decorative circle, and the headline and body sit on the overlapping circle, so the brand doesn't survive the resize. B keeps the logo prominent and centred and the can at full presence, so the original's order reads cleanly top to bottom. Its flaws: the badge is jammed against the top edge, the CTA runs almost edge to edge with tiny side and bottom margins, and the headline and body are crammed together with less hierarchy than in A.
